notes: v5: v4 variable set on the honest (as-available, expected-to-play) frame; equal-weight average of extra-trees LightGBM (10 and 25 per leaf), standard LightGBM and CatBoost; official = rank average with the FantasyPros weekly consensus
range_adjust_note: Oct 11, 2026: high end widened by k around the official projection, low end lowered by c points; fit on the 2023-2026 walk-forward (walk-forward check: about 10% of games beyond each end, from about 12%)

qb_market.note: v5.1 (Oct 12, 2026): projected starting QBs ranked by 30% model + 70% market projection (Vegas implied team points x the QB's recent share of team skill-position fantasy points in his starts) plus a cold-start offset by prior starts (fit on the 2022-2026 walk-forward); the model's own QB points are handed out in that order within the week.

ros.note: ROS (Oct 12, 2026): points = this week's official projection + games after this week x per-game rate; rate = 0.8 x this week's projection + 0.2 x the ROS rate model (players out or on bye: the ROS rate model alone); official = 50/50 rank average with the FantasyPros ROS rank, model points handed out in that order; ranges from 10th/90th percentile rate models, scaled per position (low, high) on validation seasons. Chosen on 2020-2022 walk-forward, tested on 2023-2025.

avail.note: Share of his team's remaining games (snapshot week through Week 17) a player actually played, 2020-2025 snapshots weeks 3-14, players the experts ranked (QB32 / RB60 / WR80 / TE32). active = projected this week; out = not projected this week; res = on IR / reserve.

big_games.note: Chance of a 400+ passing / 150+ rushing / 175+ receiving yard game given the player's long-run average (logistic on log of the average), fit on 2018-2025 played games; for leagues with yardage bonuses.

value.note: Undervalued / at value / overvalued (trade analyzer): our model's ROS points minus the points our model gives the player at his FantasyPros ROS consensus rank (same position, same week), per game left; >= +1.0 undervalued, <= -1.0 overvalued. Threshold chosen on 2020-2022 walk-forward snapshots (weeks 3-14) from 0.25-2.5; test 2023-2025: undervalued players finished above their market rank 56% of the time (+0.6 PPR per game vs the points at that rank), at value 41% (-0.8), overvalued 30% (-2.4); same order every season and position.

avail_curve.note: Chance he plays his team's k-th game after this week (k = 1, 2, ...; last value repeats), by position. active = played 50%+ of offensive snaps (QB 80%+) in his team's last game; out = didn't play the team's last game but did in one of the 2 before. nflverse snap counts 2021-2025, snapshot weeks 3-14, games through Week 17 (Nov 9, 2026). Out curves smoothed (3-game average) and used only for their shape: an out player's expected games come from his ROS projection.

avail_player.note: Player-specific chance to play each game (avail.py, avail_lab.py, Nov 9, 2026): logistic regression on the position curve's log-odds (curve: k = games ahead, 0 = this week's game) plus injury-report status this week and last, age, games missed this season and the two before, snap share in the team's last game. Fit on 2021-2025 starters; test 2024-2025 (fit on 2021-2023): log loss on games 1+ weeks out 0.4157 -> 0.4054, Brier 0.1256 -> 0.1223. Used for the trade analyzer / season simulation chances (play_curve); ROS points themselves are unchanged.

ros.avail_in_ros_note: Nov 9, 2026: later games' weekly part x the player's own chance to play relative to this week's (avail.py). ros_lab.score_variants, official 50/50 blend, rank corr vs production: validation 2020-22 +0.0063 +/- 0.0032 (8/12 season-positions up), test 2023-25 -0.0016 +/- 0.0031 (noise); ROS totals on all projected players: bias +6.9 / +4.0 -> +2.6 / -0.4 PPR, R2 0.644 / 0.681 -> 0.670 / 0.690, MAE 22.89 / 22.07 -> 22.14 / 21.77 (validation / test). Rejected the same round: position curve only (val -0.0002, test -0.0040), schedule-neutral weekly part (ros_neutral.py; val -0.0033 +/- 0.0044 and -0.0033 +/- 0.0022 for the official-minus-matchup version; test +0.0052 / +0.0031).

avail_out.note: Return-timing model for players out (didn't play the team's last game, not on IR); avail_out_lab.py, C=3.0, fit on 2018-2025 snapshots weeks 3-14; games ahead k=1..6 after the snapshot week.

ros.avail_out_note: Nov 23, 2026: timing of an out (not IR) player's return, avail_out.py / avail_out_lab.py: test 2024-25 (fit 2018-23) log loss 0.634 -> 0.583, Brier 0.221 -> 0.200 vs the position out curve; used for the shape only, expected games from his ROS total.

weekly_blend_note: Nov 22, 2026: official weekly = model + Sleeper + ESPN rank blend (league sims: +0.24 wins/season vs FantasyPros, model + FantasyPros +0.20). Falls back to the FantasyPros blend when either site covers < 60% of the week's upcoming players. Set to "experts" to go back.
